mapper.select: SELECT r.*, ru.nickname AS reviewer_nickname, eu.nickname AS reviewee_nickname FROM cb_review r LEFT JOIN cb_user ru ON r.reviewer_id = ru.id LEFT JOIN cb_user eu ON r.reviewee_id = eu.id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cb_review WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT r.*, ru.nickname AS reviewer_nickname, eu.nickname AS reviewee_nickname FROM cb_review r JOIN cb_order o ON r.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN cb_user ru ON r.reviewer_id = ru.id LEFT JOIN cb_user eu ON r.reviewee_id = eu.id WHERE o.item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cb_review (order_id, reviewer_id, reviewee_id, score, content, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{reviewerId}, #{revieweeId}, #{score}, #{content}, NOW())
